versions.changelog:
Sentiment Analysis Compass 1.0.0 — First release

- Launches an AI-powered sentiment monitoring & analysis tool for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Weibo, and WeChat Official Accounts.
- Monitors keywords, runs Chinese sentiment analysis (positive/neutral/negative with reason), and produces structured sentiment reports.
- Supports auto alerts via Feishu/email when negative sentiment thresholds are exceeded.
- Enables easy task management: add, list, pause, or delete keyword monitoring.
- Implements subscription tiers (Free/Std/Pro/Max) with increasing limits and platform support.
- Provides technical details, usage examples, and core Python API for integration.
